children: Azerbaijan’s central bank said on Wednesday it had left its key refinancing rate unchanged at 6.5%.
The upper bound of the interest rate corridor also remained unchanged at 7.5%, while the lower bound was set at 5%.
The next decision on the parameters of the interest rate corridor will be announced on November 4.
